title: Kurt's forgotten childhood in gifted and talented program

tellings.quote:
I I have no idea. I don't remember a
single part of it.

plain: A guest named Kurt Metzger, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says that as a child in New Jersey he was in a gifted and talented program, a special school track for bright kids. He says he has no idea what went on there and does not remember a single part of it. He raises it in a conversation about secret groups, where a blank like that would hint that something was hidden from him.
